title: Which ab initio calculation methods describe the charge transfer in ionic liquid vapors? Case study on EMIM-OTF reveals the frontier orbitals and the ionization threshold
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13283-13303
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07324C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ivar Kuusik, Antti Kivimäki, Vambola Kisand
Time-of-flight mass-spectrometry (TOF-MS) measurements of 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium trifluoromethanesulfonate ([EMIM][OTF]) vapors were conducted to gain insight into the vacuum ultraviolet absorption thresholds of a representative ionic liquid.
